scope: Read volume is projected from each distinct original checkpoint and observed realized read fractions conditioned on the actual route, with no traffic multiplier. New-cohort APC hits/Store residency are conditional, and throughput is predicted. Each state uses archived per-request EOS lengths fixed across caps. Quantiles and service states differ between AB and BA. CPU arms start from the same empty logical initial state and hold all offerings apart from the cap. The root model assumes retention of aligned local prefixes and release of the full ready successor wave. D scores are updated during the simulation. Validation for r78 freezes high observed ingress/routes and bytes.
